learnings: Type hints can drive parsing: one `coerce` function turns strings into int, bool, Path, Literal, Enum or tuples.
Collecting every problem before raising lets operators fix a configuration in one pass.
A `Secret` type whose repr is masked keeps passwords out of logs and tracebacks.
pitfalls: A typo in an environment variable name is silently ignored unless unknown keys are reported.
